parts.problem_md:
The concert venue uses an online booking system.

Customers can store a digital ticket to their smartphone and access the venue by scanning their phone.

Which **one** of these is the wireless technology used during this scan?

Gail uses different types of networks in her job.

Draw **one** straight line from** each** type of network to the correct reason for its use.

![Figure](assets/003-figure.png)

Visitors usually bring a digital device to events at the venue.

Describe **one **way a visitor can use features of a tablet to connect it to a smartphone’s mobile broadband connection.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> A description such as:
> 
> - (Connect to the smartphone using) Wi-Fi / Bluetooth (1) by selecting the device name/ SSID (1) Or
> - Create a hotspot / Tether (1) using Wi-Fi / Bluetooth (1)

parts.problem_md:
Camille creates a home network.

State what is meant by ‘tethering’.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> Any one from:
> 
> - Sharing a connection to mobile broadband
> - Connecting to the Internet via a smartphone/hotspot
> 
> **Do not accept** responses that only refer to sharing a connection to the Internet. Responses must imply the Internet connection is via mobile broadband.

parts.problem_md:
Camille connects to a LAN.

State** two **features of a LAN that are different from a WAN.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> Any two from: •
> 
> - Connects devices within a single site (e.g. a [single] building)
> - Covers a smaller geographical area/range
> - Does not use third party infrastructure/telecomms systems
> - Does not require a gateway
> 
> Accept: A WAN is a collection of LANs

parts.problem_md:
Camille’s mobile phone can receive data using 3G, 4G, 5G and GPS.

State **two** **other** wireless communication methods used by mobile phones.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> Any two from:
> 
> - Bluetooth
> - Wi-Fi
> - Infra-red / IR
> - Near-field communication / NFC

parts.problem_md:
Joe streams a radio show online.

State the type of network required to stream the show to listeners outside of Joe’s LAN.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> - WAN
> - Wide area network
> 
> Accept: Client –server

parts.problem_md:
Joe connects to different types of networks.

Joe uses networks to stream his show.

(i)

Give** two **types of wireless connectivity that Joe could use to connect a laptop to a smartphone.

[2]

(ii)

Explain one reason why Joe must use a WAN to stream a show.

[2]
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> (i)
> 
> Any two from:
> 
> - Wi-Fi
> - Bluetooth
> - Infra-red
> 
> (ii)
> 
> An explanation such as: Joe needs access to the Internet (1) because the broadcast is online (1)

parts.problem_md:

Which **one** of these statements about GPS is** true**?
parts.solution_md:

> **The correct answer is D** - The GPS system does not receive data from Joe’s devices

parts.problem_md: Which one of these is a reason why Joe would use GPS?
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> **The correct answer is B** - To include location data in image files

choices.label: A
choices.text_md: To connect to a wide area network

choices.label: B
choices.text_md: To include location data in image files

choices.label: C

choices.label: D
choices.text_md: To provide a connection if a mobile phone network fails

parts.problem_md:
Joe’s laptop uses a wired connection to the Internet through broadband.

Joe’s smartphone has mobile broadband connectivity.

The laptop loses its connection to the Internet.

Describe one method Joe could use to keep the laptop online.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> A description to include two from:
> 
> Tether/connect a laptop to a smartphone / mobile hotspot (1) using Bluetooth / Wi-Fi / USB (1) and use its 3G/4G/5G connection (1)
